definitions.rule A: a hit on target X at counted position p does not count when the token fed in at p is one of X's pinned ids (either form)
definitions.rule B: count only the counted positions up to and including the one that produces X's first occurrence: p is excluded once X is among input_ids[lp+1..p] (lp the last prompt token)
definitions.bare form: the bare form at the last prompt token, unchanged
definitions.F2 under rule B: in F2 the note usually states X before 'Answer:', so rule B mostly measures whether the note already held X
